title: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
abstract: arXiv:2610.08825v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over 600 autonomous driving datasets across nearly 50 countries. However, this abundance has not translated into broad research impact: most datasets remain significantly underused due to fragmentation, limited visibility, incompatible protocols, and benchmark incentives that concentrate attention on a few dominant datasets. translated_title: 自动驾驶研究需要社区驱动的数据范式
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶已经取得了显著进展，近年来人工智能的突破使其商业部署成为可能，正在重塑城市出行方式。然而，该领域仍远未实现其普适的社会愿景——能够随时随地、为任何人稳健运行的自主系统。我们认为，这一差距不仅仅是一个建模问题，更是当前主流数据范式的问题。尽管社区已在全球近50个国家累计创建了超过600个自动驾驶数据集，当前研究却严重依赖少数空间和场景覆盖有限的基准数据集。然而，这种数据的丰富性并未转化为广泛的研究影响力：由于数据集碎片化、可见性低、协议不兼容，以及将研究注意力集中于少数主流数据集的基准激励机制，大多数数据集仍未得到充分利用。因此，我们认为自动驾驶研究需要一个协作式的……
tldr: 自动驾驶研究的瓶颈不在建模而在数据范式，亟需建立社区驱动的协作数据机制，以充分利用全球已积累的600多个自动驾驶数据集。
en_tdlr: Autonomous driving research is bottlenecked not by modeling but by its data paradigm, and requires a community-driven, collaborative data framework to fully leverage the 600+ datasets already collected worldwide.
